annotations.text:
Why it's unusable today — from the source, not guesswork:

1. KanbanBoard.jsx renders `grid grid-cols-6` with no breakpoints. At 375px each lane is ~41px wide.
2. Cards use HTML5 drag-and-drop (draggable / onDragStart). That API does nothing on touch — so moving a track is impossible on a phone even if the lanes fit.
3. TrackDetailPanel is a fixed w-96 / max-w-2xl right panel — wider than the screen.
4. p-6 / px-6 padding eats 48px of 375px before any content.

Only 7 of 35 components carry any responsive treatment.
This sheet is the touch replacement for drag-and-drop: tap a card → Move to… → pick a lane. Same action, no dragging.

Six lanes will never fit a 375px screen, so the real decision is what replaces the side-by-side board. Three honest options — each with its trade-off. B is built out on the 'Recommended flow' page; if you'd rather have A or C, say which and I'll rebuild it there.
